configure_mask_rcnn_backbone: configure the mask-rcnn r50 model backbone with a pretrained resnet50 checkpoint from imagenet
configure_optimizer_adamw: configure the optimizer wrapper with adamw optimizer, learning rate 0.0002 and weight decay 0.05
inherit_base_config: inherit base configuration from mask-rcnn r50 fpn model, coco instance dataset, 1x schedule, and default runtime
set_pretrained_checkpoint: set the pretrained checkpoint url for the resnet50 backbone loaded from openmmlab mmclassification
override_paramwise_config: override paramwise config to disable norm decay multiplier and bypass duplicate parameters
